"""Runs a batch of items through the backend, two at a time."""

import asyncio

import drover
import provision


async def transact(items, backend):
    """The results of the items' work, in the order of items."""
    batch = drover.Batch(items, backend)
    lanes = [
        asyncio.create_task(drover.drive(batch))
        for _ in range(min(2, len(batch.items)))
    ]
    await drover.outlast(batch, lanes)
    return await provision.stop_backend(batch)
